meaning:
1) pasturing, pasturage, shepherding
1a) pasturing, shepherding
1b) pasturage
1c) flock (meton)

elsewhere.note: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’; to those who are in darkness, ‘Show yourselves!’ “They shall feed along the paths, and their pasture shall be on…
For the shepherds have become brutish, and have not inquired of Yahweh. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks have scattered.
You my sheep, the sheep of my pasture, are men, and I am your God,’ says the Lord Yahweh.”
According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me.
